vendor_and_service: CIS, billing, portal, and IVR vendor (SYS-06)
tier_rationale: Customer identity data for about 265,000 company accounts and the 4 client utilities' customers; supports BP-05, BP-07, BP-08, BP-10; subservice organization for the Utility Services SOC 2
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality) plus bridge letter
subservice_organizations: Hosting provider carved out; payment processor carved out
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 40 production changes lacked documented approval; remediated per management response
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must manage its users and roles, review access, approve its own configuration changes (rates, partitions), and protect extracts. Mapped to AC-2, AC-6, CM-3, SI-12. Company gaps: 41 bulk export users and annual reviews (POAM-012); partition change approvals (POAM-022)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 12 h and RPO 1 h; BIA needs RTO 8 h for BP-05 and billing within 1 business day for clients: **does not meet BIA** (P05 finding 4)
incident_notification_terms: Notice within 72 hours of confirming a security incident; no Red Flags or identity theft duties in the contract
follow_up: Negotiate 8-hour RTO, 24-hour incident notice, and Red Flags service provider duties at renewal (2027); request client partitions in the vendor DR test; obtain the hosting provider's report
reviewer_and_date: Information Security Manager and Director of Utility Services, 2026-09-10

tier_rationale: Usage data for 265,000 meters plus 58,000 client meters; remote connect and disconnect capability; supports BP-02, BP-06, BP-08
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability) plus bridge letter
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must assign roles, configure bulk command limits and approvals, and review command logs. Mapped to AC-5, AC-6, AU-6. Company gap: no bulk limits or two-person approval; 22 bulk users (POAM-013)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 24 h; BIA BP-06 RTO 48 h: meets BIA. Outage events to the OMS are degraded during an AMI outage (BP-02 uses calls and SCADA instead)
incident_notification_terms: Notice within 48 hours of a confirmed security incident
follow_up: Enable bulk limits; request bridge letter; add 24-hour notice at renewal

vendor_and_service: SCADA and ADMS vendor (support, patches, remote access to SYS-01 and SYS-14)
tier_rationale: Remote access to OT through the jump hosts; uses the shared SCADA administrator accounts; supports BP-01, BP-04, BP-13
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) covering the support organization and software delivery, plus a yearly service review
report_type_and_period: Type 2; 12 months ending 2026-04-30 (support and remote services only)
subservice_organizations: Software build environment carved out (covered only by the vendor's own secure development attestation)
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 3 of 25 support engineers kept access to customer jump host credentials after role change
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must control remote access (enable per session, MFA), manage shared credentials, and verify software integrity. Mapped to AC-17, MA-4, IA-5, SI-7. Company gaps: shared administrator accounts (POAM-001); no hash verification of updates (P01 R-015)
availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; vendor support SLA of 1 hour for critical SCADA issues is consistent with the BIA
incident_notification_terms: Contract: notice within 24 hours of an incident affecting customer systems or credentials
follow_up: Named vendor accounts (POAM-001); software integrity terms and build environment assurance at renewal; follow up the credential exception
reviewer_and_date: OT Engineering Manager and Information Security Manager, 2026-09-14

availability_vs_bia: Regional services meet the BIA when deployed across zones; backups in a second region
incident_notification_terms: Provider notifies affected customers of security incidents per its terms
bridge_letter: Covered by the next report (provider publishes every 6 months)

tier_rationale: Privileged EDR agents on IT and OT hosts; receives OT sensor alerts and logs; supports detection for every process

incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 30 minutes on high severity
follow_up: Request the SIEM platform provider's SOC 2; add OT detection test to the yearly service review
